message.content:
Using integration by parts:

Let u = log(x) and dv = dx.

Then du = (1/x) * dx and v = x.

So:

∫ log(x) * dx = x * log(x) - ∫ x * (1/x) * dx

= x * log(x) - ∫ 1 * dx

= x * log(x) - x + C

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
